CAMPAIGN_NAME: Impact of submarine copper mine tailing disposal from the 1970s on Repparfjorden, northern Norway
ORGANISATION: UiT The Arctic University of Norway
CAMPAIGN_COMMENT: Material collected during two cruises in April 2013 and June 2015 with R/V Helmer Hanssen. Seventeen sediment cores retrieved using multi corer (MC) or box corer (BC). Cores sliced into 1-cm thick samples and freeze-dried prior to analyses. Analyses conducted at UiT (grain size, TOC, HM for 14 cores), DTU (HM and TOC for 3 cores), and Institute of Geology Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznan (radioisotopes). Study funded by EWMA project (Research Council of Norway NORDSATSING grant 195160), EniNorge AS, and UiT.
